question: Whether existing confidence-threshold routing methods (e.g., ConfSched) incorporate a calibration step to ensure confidence scores reflect true likelihoods, or if they rely on uncalibrated model confidence.
description: If existing methods already calibrate, then the novelty of adding calibration may be reduced; if they do not, then our idea adds value.
rationale: Understanding whether calibration is already part of prior work helps assess overlap and novelty.
